title: Can Stomach Acid Dissolve Metal?
description:
Your stomach acid is powerful—but could it dissolve a metal object?

Acid can corrode some metals, but the result depends on the metal, protective coatings, concentration and time. The stomach is not an instant metal-dissolving chamber.

Gastric acid is mainly hydrochloric acid at low pH, but swallowed metal objects remain dangerous and require medical attention.

The stomach protects itself with mucus, bicarbonate and rapidly renewed lining cells.
